cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M

def bench(name, rules, npackets=1000000, W=32, plimit=10**9):
    cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":plimit,"prefix_width":W,"rules":rules,"fallback":{"class":0}}
    v=M.validate_config(cfg); prog=M.program_from_config(v)
    t0=time.time(); eng=M.Engine(prog); tb=time.time()-t0
    eng.handle({"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0}, False)
    rng=random.Random(1)
    t=0; total_ev=0
    t0=time.time()
    done=0
    while done<npackets:
        b=min(1024,npackets-done)
        pk=[]
        for i in range(b):
            t+=1
            pk.append({"flow":0,"time":t,"source":(done+i)%2,"length":rng.randint(1,2048)})
        ev=eng.handle({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}, False)
        total_ev+=len(ev["events"])
        done+=b
    el=time.time()-t0
    print(f"{name}: trie_build={tb:.2f}s stream={el:.2f}s events={total_ev} nodes={len(eng.children)} maxlen={eng.maxlen}")

# scenario 1: long matching rule chain, all positive-ish
rules=[{"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*32}]
bench("chain32-allmatch",rules,200000)

# scenario 2: 2048 rules length 8 random
rng=random.Random(2)
rules=[]
for i in range(2048):
    rg=[]
    for _ in range(8):
        lo=rng.randint(-2048,2048); hi=rng.randint(lo,2048); rg.append([lo,hi])
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":rg})
bench("2048x8-random",rules,200000)
PYEOF
